items.rationale: Frost fracture of a fitting inside the building is covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 (escape of water peril). Priced at the customary level from earlier cases.
Connection element renewed together with the fractured fitting, covered under 7.1.9.
Labour on covered pipe repair is indemnified under 7.1.7(f): 3 h at about 100/h.
Consumables used in covered work are nominally covered under 7.1.7(e). However, this line type was declined in all earlier cases under this wording.
One attendance per undertaking is indemnified under 7.1.11; the level follows cases 25 and 32 at about 40.
Leak-location equipment is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 and is expressly not an own-tool charge under 3.6. Well within the EUR 2,500 cap.

items.description: Facade damage lump sum (frozen from internal escape)
items.rationale: The render was saturated by the internal escape and then froze, which counts as escape of water under 2.4.3. As a lump sum it may duplicate the itemised work, so coverage is uncertain under 7.1.12.
Taking off the damaged render on the affected part is covered under 7.1.7(a), via 2.4.3.
Re-forming the substrate of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c); price follows case 32.
This line is unspecified and cannot be allocated to the affected area, so it is likely declined under 9.6 and 7.1.5.
Preparation of the affected substrate is covered under 7.1.7(c); price follows case 32.
Finish restoration of the affected area is covered under 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(d); price follows case 32.
Drying needed before repair of the affected part is covered under 7.1.7(c); price follows case 32.
Priming of the affected area is covered under 7.1.7(c)/(d); price follows case 32.
Labour on covered facade work is indemnified under 7.1.7(f): 5 h at about 55/h.
An unspecified surcharge that prices no work is excluded under 3.6(b) and 7.1.12; it was never paid in earlier cases.
